## Three Dimensions

| Dimension | Controls | Values |
|-----------|----------|--------|
| **Type** | Information structure | `infographic` (data, metrics, technical), `scene` (narrative, emotional), `flowchart` (processes), `comparison` (side-by-side), `framework` (models, architecture), `timeline` (history, evolution) |
| **Style** | Rendering approach | See [references/styles.md](../../upstream/references/styles.md) (Core Styles, gallery, Type × Style compatibility) |
| **Palette** | Color scheme (optional) | macaron, warm, neon — overrides style's default colors |

Combine freely (`--type infographic --style vector-illustration --palette macaron`) or use `--preset edu-visual` for type + style + palette in one flag ([references/style-presets.md](../../upstream/references/style-presets.md)). Command syntax and options: [references/usage.md](../../upstream/references/usage.md).
